jobs.title: Marketing Task Author (AI Training)
jobs.description:
About The Role

Alignerr is building a dataset of expert tasks that train and evaluate advanced AI agents on real enterprise marketing work. As a Marketing Task Author based in the Toronto area, you will design and calibrate demand and content tasks grounded in real data — drafting on-brand announcements, building competitive comparisons, and tracing campaign attribution — that require factual accuracy, brand judgment, and data-backed conclusions.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role open to experienced marketing professionals across Canada who want to contribute their expertise to the cutting edge of AI development.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: Flexible, task-based

Key Responsibilities

Author realistic marketing task prompts: on-brand announcement drafts, competitive comparison documents, and campaign attribution analysis.
Write scoring rubrics that specify factual accuracy standards, brand fit criteria, and the data logic required to confirm a conclusion is supported.
Set up task environments with the campaign data, brand guidelines, competitive intelligence, and analytics outputs needed to replicate a real marketing work scenario.
Solve each task yourself to confirm the scenario is realistic, the correct output is clear, and the rubric reflects genuine marketing judgment.
Calibrate task difficulty — adjust data complexity, brand guideline specificity, or attribution ambiguity until the task reliably challenges the model to the intended degree.
Review and correct AI-drafted task prompts or rubrics when provided.

Qualifications

Hands-on experience in a marketing role — demand generation, content marketing, product marketing, or a closely related function.
Ability to verify factual accuracy in marketing claims and confirm that stated conclusions follow from the underlying data.
Strong brand judgment: can assess whether a draft is on-brand and articulate why with specific, checkable criteria.
Comfortable working with campaign performance data, attribution reports, and competitive positioning documents.
Ability to define precise correctness criteria for marketing outputs — not just "good writing" but verifiable accuracy, brand alignment, and data support.

Nice to Have

Experience in B2B, enterprise, or technology-sector marketing within the Canadian market.
Familiarity with marketing analytics platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, Google Analytics, Looker).
Background working with North American or bilingual (English/French) marketing campaigns.

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs.
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you.
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work.
Contribute to AI development that directly shapes how technology handles real enterprise marketing challenges.
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch.

jobs.title: Finance & Accounting Task Author (AI Training)
jobs.description:
About The Role

What if your hands-on accounting experience could directly shape how AI handles real enterprise finance work? Alignerr is building a dataset of expert tasks that train and evaluate advanced AI agents on accounting reconciliation — and we're looking for experienced Canadian finance professionals to help design them.

As a Task Author, you will create realistic, numerically rigorous accounting scenarios — billing versus revenue reconciliation, payment-to-invoice matching, margin report analysis — that genuinely challenge capable AI agents while remaining objectively scorable.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role open to accountants, finance analysts, and related professionals across Canada. No AI background needed.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: Flexible, task-based

Key Responsibilities

Author realistic task prompts centered on accounting reconciliation: matching payments to invoices, reconciling billing against recognized revenue, and analyzing margin reports
Write scoring rubrics that specify exact numerical outcomes and the reasoning steps required to reach them
Set up task environments with the financial data, documents, and system states needed to replicate a realistic accounting scenario
Solve each task yourself to validate that the numbers work and the rubric is correct
Calibrate task difficulty — adjust data complexity, ambiguity in source documents, or required reasoning steps until the task reliably challenges the model to the intended degree
Review and correct AI-drafted task prompts or rubrics when provided

Qualifications

Hands-on experience as an accountant, finance analyst, or in a closely related role
Strong, precise numerical reasoning and demonstrated ability to work through multi-step reconciliation problems
Solid knowledge of revenue recognition principles, matching rules, and standard accounting workflows
Ability to define verifiable correctness criteria — exact figures, reconciled balances, or documented variance explanations
Comfortable working with financial documents, spreadsheets, and accounting system outputs
Iterative mindset: willing to test and refine tasks until difficulty and gradability are both right

Nice to Have

Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or enterprise B2B finance environments
Familiarity with ERP or accounting platforms (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, QuickBooks Enterprise)
CPA Canada designation or equivalent
Background in audit, financial controls, or revenue assurance

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work
Contribute to AI development that directly shapes how technology handles enterprise finance
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

jobs.title: Environmental Management Scientist (AI Training)
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for environmental management professionals to help shape how AI understands sustainability, land-use planning, and environmental decision-making. Your real-world expertise will directly influence the quality and accuracy of AI systems used by researchers, policymakers, and practitioners worldwide.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your knowledge genuinely matters — you're not just reviewing content, you're helping AI get environmental science right.

Organization: Alignerr (Powered by Labelbox)
Type: Hourly / Task-based Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Review and evaluate AI-generated environmental management scenarios, analyses, and recommendations
Assess the quality of AI reasoning related to sustainability frameworks, impact mitigation, and resource planning
Identify gaps between theoretical approaches and real-world environmental practice
Provide clear, structured feedback to improve the accuracy and applicability of AI outputs
Work independently and asynchronously on your own schedule

Who You Are

3+ years of hands-on experience in environmental management, conservation, or a related field
Strong working knowledge of sustainability frameworks, environmental planning, and impact assessment
Able to critically evaluate written environmental analyses with a practiced eye
Skilled at delivering detailed, structured, and constructive feedback
Self-motivated and comfortable managing your own workload remotely

Nice to Have

Master's degree in Environmental Management, Environmental Science, or a related discipline
Experience with environmental policy, regulatory compliance, or permitting frameworks
Familiarity with AI systems, content evaluation, or data annotation workflows

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects with top research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, anywhere
Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
Contribute to meaningful work that improves how AI handles real environmental challenges
Exposure to advanced large language models (LLMs) and how they're trained
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

jobs.title: Forestry and Land Management Scientist (AI Training)
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for experienced forestry and land management scientists to help shape the next generation of AI. Your field expertise will directly influence how AI systems understand, reason about, and communicate sustainable forestry and land-use practices — making a real-world impact on how this technology is used in environmental decision-making.

Organization: Alignerr (Powered by Labelbox)
Type: Hourly / Task-Based Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Review AI-generated forestry and land management scenarios for scientific accuracy and practical soundness
Assess content related to forest health, land use, sustainability, and ecosystem management
Identify errors, oversimplifications, or flawed reasoning in AI-generated recommendations
Provide structured, expert feedback to improve how AI models reason through applied environmental problems
Work independently and asynchronously on your own schedule

Who You Are

3+ years of hands-on experience in forestry, land management, or a closely related field
Strong working knowledge of forest ecosystems, silviculture, and sustainable land-use practices
Able to critically evaluate applied environmental decision-making scenarios
Comfortable reading and reviewing written technical content
Self-motivated and reliable — no prior AI experience required

Nice to Have

Degree in Forestry, Natural Resources, Environmental Science, or a related discipline
Experience with land-use planning, conservation programs, or regulatory frameworks
Familiarity with AI systems or content evaluation workflows

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects with top research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration

jobs.title: Public Policy Economist (AI Training)
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for experienced economists with a public policy background to help shape how AI understands and reasons about complex economic and policy topics. Your expertise will directly influence the quality of AI-generated analysis on regulation, welfare programs, fiscal policy, and more — work that matters at a foundational level.

Organization: Alignerr (Powered by Labelbox)
Type: Hourly / Task-based Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Review and evaluate AI-generated public policy questions, scenarios, and economic explanations used in AI training
Assess economic reasoning across topics including regulation, welfare, public programs, and fiscal policy
Provide structured, detailed feedback to improve clarity, analytical rigor, and real-world relevance
Validate economic scenarios and conclusions using your applied economics expertise
Work independently and asynchronously — on your schedule, at your pace

Who You Are

3+ years of experience working or teaching in public economics, applied economics, or a related policy field
Strong command of policy analysis frameworks and economic tradeoffs
Able to critically evaluate written economic arguments and recommendations
Clear, precise written communicator comfortable delivering detailed feedback
Self-directed and reliable when working remotely on task-based projects

Nice to Have

Graduate degree in Economics, Public Policy, or a related field
Background in government agencies, think tanks, or policy research organizations
Familiarity with AI systems or content evaluation workflows

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects with top research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
Contribute to meaningful work that improves how AI reasons about real-world policy
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension
